title: Best E-Commerce Product Video Makers (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a product video creator for your online store: what the package should include, shipping, formats, price factors and red flags.
intro: Short product videos show size, texture and how something works in a way photos cannot. They are used on product pages, marketplaces and social media. Remote product video shoots go wrong when the shipping and return of products are not planned, the formats do not match your store, or the video shows the product inaccurately. This guide helps you plan a smooth shoot.

faq.q: How do remote product video shoots work?
faq.a: You ship the product, the creator films and edits it, and sends the files. Agree on shipping, return or disposal of the product before sending anything.

faq.q: Which formats does my store need?
faq.a: Check your store and marketplaces for accepted formats, lengths and aspect ratios. Social platforms usually prefer vertical video.

faq.q: Should the video have music and text?
faq.a: Often yes, but many people watch without sound. Use on-screen text for key features, and licensed music.
Some can, at extra cost. Models may need their own release for commercial use. Ask how this is handled.

faq.q: How long should a product video be?
faq.a: Short. Show the product, the main benefits and how it is used. Longer demos can live on your website or YouTube.
